title: GMS-Senior-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**GDS – IAM MS SSO– Senior**
**Job Summary**
The SSO & Access Management Senior Consultant is responsible for providing operational support, administration, and continuous improvement of enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role supports global IAM operations through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident resolution, application onboarding, access governance, and platform optimization activities.
  
  
The consultant will work across industry-leading SSO technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring adherence to security, compliance, and service management standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L3 operational support for authentication, authorization, federation, SSO, MFA, and access-related issues.
* Monitor platform health, availability, integrations, and security events to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Manage incident, service request, problem, and change management activities in accordance with ITIL processes and SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
* Support user lifecycle management activities, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access modifications, and entitlement management.
* Lead and support onboarding of enterprise applications to SSO platforms.
* Configure and troubleshoot SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and WS-Federation integrations.
* Coordinate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders during onboarding and enhancement activities.
* Manage certificates, metadata updates, federation configurations, and authentication policies.
* Support periodic access reviews, certification campaigns, and audit activities.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security standards, compliance requirements, and IAM best practices.
* Assist in implementation and maintenance of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and access governance processes.
* Maintain operational and technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Drive continuous service improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Identify automation opportunities for repetitive operational tasks and reporting.
* Provide recommendations for improving authentication and access management processes.
* Collaborate closely with business application owners, security teams, infrastructure teams, and IAM stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior analysts and team members.
* Participate in governance meetings, operational reviews, and client/service management discussions.
* Prepare operational reports, dashboards, KPI metrics, SLA performance reports, and management updates.

**Preferred Skills**

* 3-6 years of experience in identity and access management, with a strong focus on Okta/Ping Federate or similar IAM platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of IAM principles, SSO, MFA, directory services, and cloud identity management.
* Proven track record of managing complex user provisioning and de-provisioning scenarios.
* Familiarity with IT security standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Strong leadership abilities and experience mentoring junior staff.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with various stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Consultant, Okta Certified Professional) are highly desirable

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.

**Work Requirements**

* Willingness to work in rotational shifts supporting global operations.
* Willingness to participate in on-call support rotations.
* Ability to support critical production incidents outside standard business hours when required.
* Willingness to travel occasionally based on business requirements.
* Ability to work effectively within a Managed Services delivery model.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Softmed Technologies LLP provides innovative, cost-effective software solutions tailored to the healthcare industry, with a core focus on medical imaging and telehealth. The company develops modern systems that automate medical imaging procedures and streamline clinical workflows. Softmed Technologies emphasizes indigenous innovation to address local healthcare challenges through technology. Its mission is to enhance healthcare accessibility, particularly for underserved populations, by delivering robust, scalable digital solutions. Team members contribute to products that directly improve patient care and expand the reach of medical services.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Technical Support Engineer role is based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The role involves providing technical support for healthcare software applications, including installation assistance, configuration, and user guidance. Daily tasks include diagnosing and troubleshooting technical issues, resolving support tickets, documenting solutions, and escalating complex problems to engineering teams when required. The Technical Support Engineer will interact with customers and internal stakeholders via phone, email, and remote sessions to ensure timely, accurate resolution of issues and a positive user experience. The role also includes maintaining knowledge bases, participating in product testing, and sharing feedback to help improve system performance and reliability.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Technical Support and Troubleshooting skills to diagnose, analyze, and resolve software and system issues efficiently.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret logs, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions.
* Candidates should possess Customer Support and Customer Service skills to handle inquiries professionally, communicate clearly, and maintain high satisfaction levels.
* Relevant experience with healthcare or medical imaging software, telehealth platforms, or other enterprise applications is beneficial.
* Familiarity with Windows/Linux environments, networks, databases, and remote support tools is an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
* Ability to work on-site in the Kolkata metropolitan area, manage multiple tickets, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* A diploma or degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

description:

**Cyber Managed Services – Privileged Identity & Access Management – Senior Consultant (BeyondTrust PAM – Operations)**
We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Consultant – BeyondTrust PAM Operations to join our Cyber Managed Services team. This role focuses on delivering ongoing operational support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of BeyondTrust PAM environments for our clients. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in BeyondTrust operations, strong troubleshooting skills, and a commitment to ensuring secure and reliable access to privileged systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 operational support for BeyondTrust PAM-related issues, including access failures, session management disruptions, and system performance concerns.
* Perform day-to-day administration of privileged accounts within the BeyondTrust platform — including provisioning, deprovisioning, access reviews, and policy updates as per change requests.
* Monitor BeyondTrust system health and logs proactively; perform regular housekeeping activities to ensure availability, stability, and performance.
* Coordinate with client IT/security teams to maintain alignment with security policies, operational procedures, and audit requirements related to PAM.
* Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and runbooks; contribute to documentation and knowledge base for consistent operations.
* Perform routine health checks, validations, and access audits; work on remediation of findings from internal or external audits.

* Solid understanding of processes and methodologies related to Varian product areas, including product specification, development, expansion, security, and safety.
* High level of self-motivation and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining effective collaboration with the broader team.
* Comfort with working within a horizontal organizational structure.

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance practice supports global EY client–serving teams with their reviews across industry sectors, including financial services, manufacturing and technology, among others. title: Salesforce Service Cloud Administrator
description:
**Why join Safeguard Global?**
👀
  
  
We want to help you
**“work in any way**
” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work. 🚀
  
  
Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first — they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for a
**job that works for you. ✅**
**The role in a nutshell:**
We are seeking a Salesforce Administrator to support the management and ongoing optimization of Safeguard Global’s Salesforce Service Cloud platform. Reporting to the Senior Salesforce Administrator, this role will help maintain the day-to-day operations of Service Cloud, support system enhancements, and assist with user requests and troubleshooting. The Salesforce Administrator will work closely with support and operations teams to translate business needs into platform configurations, automation, and reporting capabilities that improve service delivery and operational efficiency. While the primary focus of this role is Service Cloud, the administrator should maintain a general awareness of Sales Cloud functionality to ensure alignment across the broader Salesforce ecosystem. This role will also support the adoption of Salesforce AI capabilities, including Agentforce, helping implement automation and intelligent service workflows that enhance support operations and improve the overall customer experience.
  
  
**How you will make a difference:**

* Support the day-to-day administration of Salesforce Service Cloud, ensuring system stability, usability, and performance.
* Work closely with the Senior Salesforce Administrator to implement system enhancements and platform improvements.
* Configure and maintain Salesforce features including custom objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, and automation flows.
* Assist with user management, including account setup, permissions, and role-based access controls.
* Provide frontline support for Salesforce users by troubleshooting issues and responding to support requests.
* Collaborate with operations and support teams to gather and document business requirements for system enhancements.
* Assist with maintaining data quality and integrity through monitoring, data cleanup, and governance practices.
* Support testing, validation, and deployment of Salesforce updates and new features.
* Assist with the configuration and monitoring of AI-powered capabilities such as Agentforce agents and service automation workflows.
* Collaborate with technical teams to define, test, monitor, and troubleshoot MuleSoft integrations that enable reliable data exchange and workflow synchronization between Salesforce Service Cloud, Jira, Workday, and other business platforms
* Document system configurations, processes, and user guides to support internal knowledge sharing.
* Maintain awareness of Sales Cloud processes and data structures to ensure alignment across the Salesforce platform.

**What will give you an advantage:**

* 3+ years of experience working with Salesforce
* Salesforce Administrator Certification (ADM 201) preferred
* Experience supporting Salesforce Service Cloud environments.
* Knowledge of day to day workings in AWS Telephony platform for inbound and outbound contact handling
* Working knowledge of MuleSoft integration capabilities, connectors, APIs, authentication, data mapping, and flow monitoring to support integrations between Salesforce Service Cloud and platforms such as Jira and Workday
* Basic familiarity with Sales Cloud concepts and objects to maintain cross-platform awareness.
* Experience configuring Salesforce features such as objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.
* Exposure to Salesforce Flow or automation tools is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce AI capabilities such as Agentforce or Einstein AI
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical configurations
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

**Who we are and what we do:**
  
  
Safeguard Global is…global!
**We enable global expansion without the risk**
by helping 1,500+ customers recruit, hire, manage, and pay employees in nearly 190 countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. 🌎
  
  
**Our Global Benefits**
:
  
  

* 👨‍💻 Autonomy and Flexibility (work in any way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include life needs like school runs and gym breaks in your schedule, all while maintaining a high standard of work.
* 🌴 Generous leave: Enjoy a competitive leave package including paid bonding leaves for new additions to your family
* 🎁 Make a difference: Get 2 paid charitable days off to contribute to causes you believe in
* 💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
* ✈️ International environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
* ⭐ Human centered culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
* 📚 Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace.

  
  
**Next Steps:**
  
  
To apply, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time.
  
  
**Welcome to the Future of Work!**
🌐
  
  
At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

The ideal candidate possesses deep hands-on expertise in
**SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebates, settlements, and accruals—complemented by strong domain knowledge in
**Sales & Distribution (SD)**
and
**Pricing**
. In this role, you will lead enhancement deliveries, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support to ensure seamless business operations and Order-to-Cash (O2C) integration.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enhancements, Projects & Business Analysis
* Enhancement Delivery: Lead and deliver enhancements in CCM processes, including designing new contract types, complex settlement logic, and business-specific rebate models.
* Requirement Gathering: Engage with business stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement settings, and seamless integration points with financial modules.
* Technical Collaboration: Partner closely with ABAP/technical teams during custom development, code walk-throughs, unit testing, and deployment.
* Testing & Deployment: Drive System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles, ensuring defect-free releases into production environments.
* Process Optimization: Identify opportunities for automation and process optimization across CCM and pricing frameworks.
* Application Support & Maintenance (L2/L3)
* Production Support: Provide high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM processes, ensuring strict SLA adherence and minimal operational disruption.
* Issue Resolution: Diagnose and resolve complex incidents related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing inconsistencies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring issues and implement preventive, sustainable fixes.
* ITSM Ticket Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets efficiently within enterprise ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and troubleshoot period-end settlement runs and financial postings.
* Cross-Module Integration & Governance
* SD/FI Alignment: Collaborate effectively with SD and FI/CO teams to resolve cross-functional issues and ensure accurate O2C financial integration.
* Pricing Accuracy: Leverage deep SD and Pricing expertise to maintain calculation schema integrity and pricing determination rules.
* Change Governance: Strictly adhere to transport management, release governance, and change management procedures (CAB approvals) for all system changes.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain accurate functional design documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions for peer teams.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Technical & Functional Expertise
  
  

* SAP CCM: 4+ years of focused experience configuring and supporting S/4HANA Condition Contract Management (Customer/Vendor Rebates, Chargebacks, Accruals, and Settlements).
* SAP SD & Pricing: Strong expertise in SD core processes (O2C), pricing procedures, condition technique, access sequences, and condition types.
* SAP FI Integration: Working knowledge of G/L accounting, account determination, split settlements, and revenue recognition impacts.
* RICEF Development: Proven track record in creating detailed functional designs for custom reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.
* ITSM & Tools: Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Solution Manager, ChaRM, or similar change control frameworks.

Experience & Education
  
  

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP consulting experience across both Application Maintenance (Support) and Enhancement/Implementation projects.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* S/4HANA Exposure: Hands-on experience operating in S/4HANA environments is mandatory.
* Certifications (Preferred): SAP Certified Application Associate – S/4HANA Sales or SAP S/4HANA Condition Contract Management.

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset with strong root cause analysis and troubleshooting abilities.
* Communication: Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills for engaging with both business key users and technical developers.
* Leadership: Ability to independently manage tasks, mentor junior support team members, and drive delivery timelines.
* Stakeholder Management: Experienced in facilitating workshops, prioritizing backlog items, and managing business user expectations during critical issue resolution.

title: Microsoft 365 Support Engineer – L2/L3_3+yrs
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Support Engineer to manage, administer, and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft Entra ID, and related security and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in L2/L3 troubleshooting, Active Directory, MDM/MAM, identity and access management, and Microsoft 365 security administration.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft 365 Administration: Administer, manage, and troubleshoot Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and other Microsoft 365 services.
* Identity and Access Management: Manage Microsoft Entra ID, user and group administration, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access policies, Single Sign-On (SSO), and access-related issues.
* Exchange Online Administration: Troubleshoot mailbox access, mail flow, transport rules, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, email delivery, Outlook connectivity, and Exchange Online migrations.
* Security and Compliance: Support Microsoft Purview, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), retention policies, eDiscovery, and Microsoft 365 security configurations.
* L2/L3 Troubleshooting: Handle escalated incidents, perform root-cause analysis, resolve complex technical issues, and coordinate with Microsoft Support for product-related escalations.
* MDM/MAM Management: Administer and troubleshoot Mobile Device Management (MDM) and Mobile Application Management (MAM), preferably using Microsoft Intune. Support device enrollment, compliance policies, application protection policies, and device configuration.
* Active Directory (AD) Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot Active Directory issues related to user accounts, groups, authentication, permissions, Group Policy, and directory synchronization with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Incident and Service Request Management: Manage incidents, service requests, and change requests in accordance with defined SLAs and IT service management processes.
* Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor Microsoft 365 service health, maintain technical documentation, prepare operational reports, and identify recurring issues.
* L1 Support Guidance: Provide technical guidance to L1 engineers, assist with complex escalations, and contribute to knowledge base documentation and process improvements.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft 365 environments.
* Strong expertise in Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, Conditional Access, SSO, and identity management.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, MDM/MAM, device compliance, and application protection policies.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, authentication, and directory synchronization.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, DLP, retention policies, eDiscovery, and security configurations.
* Strong L2/L3 troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience managing incidents, service requests, and changes within defined SLAs.
* Good communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Microsoft 365 administration or security certifications.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365 administration and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based service management processes.
* Experience coordinating with Microsoft Support and handling critical escalations.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
A technically strong Microsoft 365 professional who can independently manage escalated issues across messaging, collaboration, identity, endpoint management, security, and Active Directory while ensuring service availability and SLA compliance.

The Network team is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of the network service/product. Team members may work to rollout new functionality and upgrades and provide 24x7 support for the ongoing operations.

+ LAN and WiFi network upgrade
+ SD-WAN routing or QoS features
+ New connectivity between on-premise and cloud environments
+ A new remote site office network
+ New RADIUS or ACS authentication servers
+ A new VPN connection with a business partner
+ Network connectivity for IoT devices
+ Improved monitoring or automation capabilities

* Incident Resolution

+ WAN Link Failure
+ LAN Switch Failure / Replacement
+ WiFi Unable to Connect

* Maintaining

+ Current OS/code levels on devices
+ Documentation (diagrams, SOPs, config guidelines)
+ Toolsets (e.g., monitoring, authentication)

The Specialist also needs strong written and verbal (speaking) communication skills.
  
  
Sample Experience:
  
  

* 4+ years deep experience with one or more Cisco WiFi, LAN, or WAN technologies
* 1+ years’ experience with all of Cisco WiFi, LAN, and SD-WAN technologies
* Familiarity with Active Directory, DHCP, and various client and server OS’s
* 1+ years with network load balancers, VPN’s, and cloud networking
* 1+ years’ experience with multiple network tools and/or authentication servers
* Prior experience in either a network operations team
* Experience solving problems using packet capture analysis
* Experience with supporting manufacturing plant floor operations

title: ST - Telco-Aria Billing Cloud -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting – Senior – Telecom Billing Analyst**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Telecom Billing Domain Analyst, you will help clients assess, design and implement telecom BSS billing solutions. You will bring strong telecom billing-domain knowledge and hands-on experience with platforms such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or comparable telecom billing and monetization products. If you have hands-on experience for Aria Billing Cloud, it will be an added advantage.
  
  
You will work with a strong focus on providing managed services and stable production operations of deployed billing platforms. You will work with telecom customer’s business, IT, finance, operations and vendor teams to translate business requirements into practical billing processes and solution designs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the telecom billing-domain specialist across production support, managed services, consulting, implementation and migration engagements. Hands-on experience in Aria Billing Cloud will be a definitive advantage.
* Investigate production billing issues, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution across product, integration, data and operations teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy, operational efficiency, revenue assurance, customer experience and time to market.
* Work effectively with client stakeholders, product vendors, system integrators and distributed delivery teams.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops and document as-is and to-be billing processes, requirements, pain points, controls and business rules.
* Translate business requirements into functional designs, user stories, configuration requirements, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Support billing transformation decisions covering platform consolidation, legacy modernization, product and pricing migration, integration rationalization and phased decommissioning.
* Define and review migration requirements for customer accounts, billing accounts, products, services, balances, open items and billing history.
* Support data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, mock migration, parallel billing, cutover and post-migration validation activities.
* Define and deliver solution designs, interface specifications, test strategies, test cases and migration-reconciliation reports for billing completeness and accuracy.
* Support system integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, bill validation, cutover rehearsals and production support.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 4–8 years of experience in telecom BSS, with significant techno-functional, hands-on experience in billing and revenue management.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major billing platform such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or an equivalent platform. Hands-on experience on Aria Billing will be a definitive advantage.
* Strong understanding of the telecom billing lifecycle, including customer and billing-account management, product and pricing configuration, usage processing, rating, recurring and one-time charges, bill calculation, invoicing, taxation, payments, adjustments, collections and dunning.
* Hands-on proficiency in Java, XML, SQL, APIs, data-analysis tools and cloud environments is required.
* Should be willing to work in shifts
* Experience migrating customers, accounts, products, subscriptions, balances and billing history from one billing platform to another.
* Knowledge of billing data profiling, mapping, cleansing, mock migrations, financial reconciliation, parallel billing, fallout management and cutover validation.
* Experience in production support or managed services for billing products, including incident, problem, change and release management; bill-cycle monitoring; root-cause analysis; defect resolution; and SLA-based support.
* Understanding of integrations between billing and CRM, order management, mediation, charging, product catalog, payment, tax, ERP/general ledger, customer-care and reporting platforms.
* Working knowledge of TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open Digital Architecture and Open APIs, particularly billing-account and customer-bill management.
* Experience preparing functional specifications, process flows, business requirements, user stories, solution-design inputs and test scenarios.
* Experience in leveraging latest AI tools to deliver projects within time, budget and quality.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant TM Forum or billing-product certifications are an advantage.

**What We Look For**
Highly motivated telecom billing professionals who combine strong domain knowledge with hands-on delivery experience. You should be able to analyze complex billing scenarios, translate requirements into practical solutions and support clients through transformation, migration and production support operations while maintaining a clear focus on billing accuracy, revenue integrity and customer outcomes.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Functional Lead / Senior Consultant**
with

**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**

**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

Your efforts will directly impact our customers’ ability to enhance productivity, improve patient care, and elevate quality by optimizing their technical and clinical competencies, image quality, workflow, and protocol management.
  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

* Provide technical and clinical leadership during the sales process by demonstrating the full range of Ultrasound products, including potential uses, product capabilities, and customer benefits.
* Coordinate, schedule, and execute objective-based system training for customers and channel partners; monitor and report on training outcomes.
* Develop and deliver product training to customers on equipment usage.
* Monitor customer installations of ultrasound products within the assigned territory/region to enhance customer satisfaction and maintain strong relationships.
* Support trade shows and professional conferences by conducting product demonstrations and customer training sessions.
* Leverage market and product knowledge to assist the sales team in developing effective sales, marketing, and customer service strategies.
* Build and maintain relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) in the region; responsible for training the sales and dealer teams periodically to enhance their capabilities.
* Penetrate competitive accounts and provide current market intelligence to the business.
* Promote new product features (NPI) and clinical techniques; collaborate with customers to develop training plans and strategies that support new product adoption and ongoing training needs in Ultrasound.
* Serve as the focal point for the modality/team by identifying customer satisfaction issues, assisting with escalations, resolving problems, and addressing specialty training requests.
* Advocate for and support the adoption of hybrid training delivery models for customers.
* Maintain well-documented pre- and post-training records in alignment with global guidelines.
* Responsible for pre- and post-sales support of ultrasound systems. Responsibilities include conducting clinical activities such as workshops, CMEs, webinars, and hands-on training.
* The incumbent will be based as per requirement and will support the LCT (Local Customer Team) or the Region depending on the scope of priority.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree/ Diploma with 5+ years of experience in MNC as Ultrasound applications is required.
* Experience in Fetal Medicine, General Imaging, OB/GYN, Vascular Sonography, and Cardiology applications is essential

title: Professional Services Engineer
description:
**ABOUT XPLORETEQ**

Xploreteq is a Pune-based technology and cybersecurity company working with organisations across cybersecurity, AI governance, data protection and DPDP readiness — through advisory, implementation and managed services. We are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, serve 50+ enterprise customers across financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing and services, and partner with leading platforms including Netskope, CrowdStrike, Menlo Security, Proofpoint, Okta, Varonis and Forcepoint. As we scale our team across sales, delivery and operations, we're looking for people who want to build a specialist practice rather than join a generalist IT shop.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a client-facing Professional Services Engineer to lead the technical implementation, architecture and integration of edge security solutions for our enterprise clients. Working from a System Integrator perspective, you will assess client environments, design the deployment architecture, and execute migrations onto modern Zero-Trust platforms — bridging legacy infrastructure (on-prem proxies, MPLS) and cloud-native SASE/SSE.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Assessment & Design**

•   Lead technical discovery workshops to map legacy architecture, application portfolios and traffic flows.

•   Author High-Level and Low-Level Design documentation covering traffic steering, proxy chaining, SSL decryption policy and fallback mechanisms.

•   Help clients plan prerequisites — allowlists, firewall exceptions, certificate authority provisioning, IdP sync.

**SASE/SSE Implementation**

•   Build, configure and validate tenants covering Secure Web Gateway, CASB and ZTNA.

•   Implement DLP policies aligned to client regulatory requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, DPDP) with custom detection rules.

•   Configure traffic steering and client deployment via MDM/GPO, including bypass and smart-steering rules.

•   Deploy Remote Browser Isolation and content-sanitisation (CDR) controls where in scope.

**Integration & Go-Live**

•   Integrate platforms with client Identity Providers (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta) for provisioning and group-based policy.

•   Configure log/event forwarding into the client's SIEM (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.).

•   Design and execute UAT test matrices; provide post-go-live hypercare support; run technical training and handover sessions for the client's internal operations team.

**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

•   3–6 years as a Cyber Security Engineer, Consultant or Professional Services engineer, ideally within a System Integrator or MSP.

•   Hands-on deployment experience with at least one SASE/SSE platform (Netskope preferred) or isolation platform (Menlo Security); familiarity with a second (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Forcepoint) is a strong plus.

•   Working knowledge of proxy configuration (PAC files, explicit vs. transparent), GRE/IPsec tunnelling, TLS/SSL inspection and routing fundamentals.

•   Experience deploying endpoint agents at scale via Intune, SCCM, JAMF or GPO.

**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS**

•   Netskope Cloud Security Integrator (NCSI) or Cloud Security Administrator (NCSA).

•   Palo Alto PCNSE, CISSP or CCSP are a plus.

**COMPETENCIES & SOFT SKILLS**

•   Comfortable walking into varied, unpredictable client environments and deploying a modern security stack on top of messy legacy networks.

•   Strong documentation discipline for HLD/LLDs and runbooks.

•   Able to run more than one client engagement at different lifecycle stages at once.

**SAP TRM Senior - Job Description**
**Treasury Management Systems Specialist - Senior**
**Job Summary**
We are seeking Senior professionals to provide functional, technical, and implementation support for SAP Treasury and Risk Management (SAP TRM) and related Treasury Management Systems (TMS). The role will support payment processing, system reliability, banking integrations, documentation, testing, and compliance with global banking standards while working closely with treasury, IT, banking, and implementation teams.
  
  
The Senior will contribute to end-to-end SAP TRM implementation activities, including requirement gathering, configuration support, testing, deployment, defect resolution, and post-go-live support under the guidance of project leads and managers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain and support SAP TRM and related TMS platforms, including incident resolution, enhancement support, upgrades, patches, and troubleshooting.
* Contribute to implementation projects for SAP TRM, including requirement gathering, configuration, documentation, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Support configuration for SAP Cash Management, Bank Account Management (BAM), In-House Cash, payment formats / DMEE, and bank statement integration.
* Assist in solution design discussions and client workshops by preparing inputs, capturing requirements, and documenting functional outcomes.
* Prepare functional specifications, configuration documents, test scripts, user guides, and process documentation.
* Support UAT, regression testing, defect analysis, and coordination with technical teams for issue resolution.
* Maintain master data for bank accounts, counterparties, entities, payment methods, and related treasury objects.
* Configure and monitor payment workflows to support secure, controlled, and efficient payment processing.
* Support bank connectivity setup including SWIFT FIN/FileAct, Host-to-Host, SFTP, and API-based connectivity.
* Support integration of bank statements such as CAMT.05x, MT94x, and BAI2 with ERP and treasury systems for reconciliation.
* Prepare dashboards, operational reports, and status updates for liquidity, payments, reconciliation, and implementation progress.
* Act as a point of contact for assigned workstreams, client queries, and operational issues, escalating risks and blockers as needed.
* Support onboarding of new entities, enhancements, and treasury process improvements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with SAP TRM and one or more TMS / Payment Hub platforms such as FIS Quantum, FIS Integrity, Kyriba, Trax, GTreasury, or Reval.
* Implementation experience in SAP TRM or SAP Treasury modules, preferably across at least two end-to-end implementation / rollout / enhancement projects.
* Working knowledge of SAP Cash Management, Bank Account Management (BAM), In-House Cash, payment formats / DMEE, bank statement integration, and ERP-TMS connectivity.
* Good understanding of treasury operations, payment workflows, banking integrations, and financial messaging standards.
* Familiarity with SWIFT, ERP integration, payment files, bank statements, and treasury system interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in SAP TRM / Treasury Management Systems / payment operations / implementation support.
* Experience supporting at least two end-to-end SAP TRM, treasury system, payment hub, or treasury transformation implementations is preferred.

title: Tech Support Engineer
description:
At Vehere, we’re not just building cybersecurity products, we’re shaping the future of how organizations detect, understand, and respond to evolving cyber threats.
 



 As a Tech Support Engineer, you’ll be part of a high\-caliber team solving complex, real\-world security challenges. You’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful technology, collaborate with talented people across teams and geographies, and turn bold ideas into solutions that make a measurable impact.
 



 We’re looking for people who are curious, driven, and ready to challenge the status quo, people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and build things that matter.
 



 If you’re ready to push boundaries, solve problems that matter, and help shape the next generation of cybersecurity, we’d love to have you build the future with us.
 



**Job Summary:** 




 We are looking for a highly motivated and customer\-focused Customer Support \& Professional Services Engineer with strong expertise in Firewall, cybersecurity, and network infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for deploying, integrating, and supporting Vehere’s AI\-powered network security solutions across enterprise environments. You will work closely with customer SOC teams, network engineers, and internal product teams to ensure successful implementation, optimal performance, and rapid issue resolution.
 



**Key Roles and Responsibilities:** 



* Deliver end\-to\-end deployment and professional services for Vehere firewall solutions, including installation, configuration, integration, and optimization.
* Provide Level 1/Level 2 technical support to enterprise customers, ensuring timely resolution and excellent customer experience.
* Monitor firewall logs, security events, and traffic patterns to identify suspicious activities, security threats, performance bottlenecks, and policy violations.
* Perform firewall health checks, firmware upgrades, patch management, and security hardening activities to ensure optimal device performance and compliance.
* Collaborate with SOC, Network, and Security teams to investigate security alerts, support incident response activities, and strengthen network security posture.
* Troubleshoot complex firewall and network security issues by analyzing traffic flows, packet captures (PCAP), routing configurations, and firewall logs, escalating cases to Engineering when required.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for security incidents, network outages, and firewall\-related service disruptions, providing actionable recommendations and preventive measures.
* Support firewall migration, rule\-base review, policy optimization, and change management activities while minimizing business impact and ensuring compliance with security standards.
* Apply strong knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, Routing, Switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and cybersecurity principles to support secure and resilient network environments.
* Work with leading firewall technologies and security features such as Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), URL Filtering, Application Control, Anti\-Malware, and Threat Intelligence integrations.
* Adhere to high\-quality work standards.
* Responsible for maintaining Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability of Vehere’s information assets including business critical information.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electronics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in Firewall Support, Network Security, Technical Support, or Professional Services.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise firewall technologies and network security solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting skills involving routing, switching, VPNs, NAT, packet capture analysis, and security event investigation.
* Familiarity with Linux systems and command\-line troubleshooting is desirable.
* Working knowledge of SIEM, SOC operations, and incident response processes is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer\-facing abilities.
* Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Security, CEH, NSE, PCNSE, or equivalent are preferred.

title: Senior Specialist - Power BI & Microsoft Fabric Administrator
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Senior Specialist \- Power BI \& Microsoft Fabric Administrator
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32401**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Senior Specialist in this position should be a highly skilled Power BI \& Microsoft Fabric Administrator to support and advance our enterprise self service BI strategy. This role focuses heavily on platform and capacity administration, governance, security, and operational excellence within Power BI and Microsoft Fabric. A strong understanding of BI development concepts (datasets, semantic models, dataflows, pipelines) is required to effectively support business publishers and guide self service users. This position also includes limited support for our existing Tableau environment during transition, ensuring continuity while organizational reporting shifts toward Power BI and Fabric.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* You will be managing and administrating Power BI/ Fabric capacities across Linde
* You will create and maintain workspaces, enforce workspace governance, and assist users with migration to Fabric experiences
* You must have experience with Fabric workload orchestration OneLake management, Lakehouse \& Warehouse provisioning, Pipeline orchestration and monitoring, Fabric capacities and workload configuration (Lakehouse, Warehouse, KQL DB, Notebooks, Data Engineering, Real\-Time Intelligence)
* Proficiency with Power BI Admin APIs, Fabric APIs, and automation frameworks
* Also, strong understanding of Azure AD / Entra ID concepts
* You must have knowledge of Row\-Level Security (RLS) and Object\-Level Security (OLS) design patterns to guide self‑service developers


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* You must have 3–7 years supporting Power BI/Fabric or enterprise BI platforms
* Along with strong understanding of BI development (Power BI datasets, dataflows, semantic models, pipelines)
* Experience with governance and enterprise BI support models
* You must excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills
* And the ability to work with distributed teams and support global users


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com

title: DAT System Transformation - SAP - Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a DAT Tech Solutions\-SAP\-Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in assisting clients with business transformations by leveraging large\-scale digital solutions such as SAP. Within our Assurance practice, you will focus on evaluating compliance with regulations and assessing governance and risk management processes. As a Senior Associate, you will utilize your skills to analyze complex problems, mentor others, and maintain professional standards. You will be responsible for building meaningful client connections and developing a deeper understanding of the business context.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work on diverse engagements across both audit and non\-audit clients, providing insights into internal controls, governance, and risk management processes. You will guide clients through their transformation journey, utilizing innovative solutions to manage risk and controls. Your ability to navigate complexity and inspire others will be key as you contribute to the success of our firm. Embracing technology and innovation, you will enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same, while continuously developing your personal brand and technical skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assisting clients in business transformations by leveraging SAP digital solutions to enhance internal controls and governance processes
* Conducting assessments of ERP security, business processes, and IT General Controls to identify potential risks and recommend improvements
* Leading walkthroughs with clients to evaluate business and IT processes, confirming compliance with regulatory standards
* Testing IT applications and automated controls within business processes such as Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, and Record to Report
* Reviewing and validating key reports to address risks related to Information Produced by Entity (IPE)
* Collaborating with engagement managers to scope and plan client engagements effectively
* Preparing detailed reports and deliverables for clients and stakeholders, highlighting key findings and recommendations
* Developing and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to support business opportunities
* Coaching and mentoring junior team members to enhance their skills and knowledge in system transformation projects
* Managing project economics and confirming efficient resource allocation for engagement teams


 What You Must Have
   

  

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in accounting, Management Information Systems or equivalent,
   

  

* At least 4\-7 years of experience
* Demonstrating, in addition to the minimum years of experience required for the role, experience in SAP/Oracle controls auditing, consulting and/or implementing, data analysis, compliance, internal audit, or risk.
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Possessing Chartered Accountant certification
* Holding certifications such as CISA, CISSP, or CISM
* Demonstrating experience with SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)
* Utilizing ERP System Integration skills
* Applying analytical thinking to complex business transformations
* Engaging in business process improvement initiatives
* Navigating SAP Supply Chain Management (SAP SCM) solutions

**Position Overview:**
 The Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – IT is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability and day\-to\-day support of IT infrastructure and end\-user systems across operational and administrative locations within the assigned region. The role coordinates IT support activities, manages vendor service delivery, resolves infrastructure issues and ensures minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, HR and Corporate IT teams, the role provides first and second\-level support for IT infrastructure, end\-user computing, hardware, software and network\-related issues while ensuring adherence to service levels, IT standards and information security requirements.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To provide reliable, responsive and efficient IT support across the assigned region by ensuring timely resolution of technology issues, effective vendor coordination, high system availability and uninterrupted business operations through proactive infrastructure support and adherence to IT governance standards.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Regional IT Operations Support**
* Provide day\-to\-day IT support across all operational and administrative locations within the assigned region, ensuring high system availability and minimal business disruption.
* Coordinate resolution of hardware, software, network and system\-related issues impacting business operations.
* Ensure operational locations receive timely IT support in accordance with defined service levels.
* Provide on\-site support for critical IT issues where remote resolution is not feasible.
* Support regional IT readiness for new branch openings, relocations, expansions and operational infrastructure changes.


**Incident \& Service Request Management**
* Manage IT incidents and service requests from logging through resolution, ensuring adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Prioritise and coordinate resolution of business\-critical incidents impacting operational continuity.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting and coordinate with specialised support teams for second and third\-level issues.
* Track recurring incidents, identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, escalation records and service request updates.


**End User Computing \& Infrastructure Support**
* Support end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, handheld devices, scanners and other operational IT equipment.
* Coordinate installation, configuration and maintenance of approved hardware, software and peripheral devices.
* Ensure timely provisioning and replacement of IT equipment for employees and operational locations.
* Support connectivity, user access, system availability and peripheral device functionality across the region.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance activities to maximise infrastructure reliability and equipment uptime.


**Vendor Management \& Service Delivery**
* Coordinate and monitor regional IT support vendors to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs and escalate service gaps where required.
* Validate completion of vendor activities and ensure quality of work performed.
* Coordinate warranty repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and third\-party support activities.
* Build effective working relationships with vendor partners to ensure uninterrupted IT support across the region.


**IT Asset \& Inventory Management**
* Maintain accurate records of regional IT assets including desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handheld devices and networking equipment.
* Coordinate asset allocation, movement, replacement and disposal in accordance with organisational policies.
* Support periodic IT asset verification and inventory audits.
* Ensure software licensing, asset tagging and documentation remain accurate and up to date.
* Monitor asset lifecycle and recommend timely replacement of ageing or obsolete equipment.


**Business Continuity \& Operational Readiness**
* Support business continuity by ensuring IT systems remain operational across all regional locations.
* Coordinate IT readiness for new operational sites, office relocations and infrastructure expansion projects.
* Participate in disaster recovery activities, system recovery testing and operational contingency planning where applicable.
* Ensure critical operational systems supporting logistics and customer service remain available with minimal downtime.
* Provide IT support during peak business periods and critical operational events to ensure uninterrupted business operations.


**Information Security \& IT Governance**
* Ensure compliance with organisational IT policies, information security standards and regulatory requirements across all regional locations.
* Support implementation of IT security controls, endpoint protection, user access management and system compliance initiatives.
* Coordinate timely installation of software updates, security patches and antivirus definitions in collaboration with Corporate IT and support vendors.
* Report IT security incidents, system vulnerabilities and policy deviations, ensuring timely corrective actions.
* Promote awareness of information security best practices among regional users.


**Cross\-functional Stakeholder Support**
* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance, HR and other business functions to understand IT support requirements and ensure timely service delivery.
* Coordinate with Corporate IT teams for system upgrades, application deployments, infrastructure enhancements and enterprise\-wide IT initiatives.
* Provide IT support for new branch openings, relocations, office expansions and operational infrastructure changes.
* Assist business users during rollout of new applications, hardware and technology solutions.
* Maintain effective communication with stakeholders regarding incident status, planned maintenance and system availability.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring IT issues and recommend process improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of new technologies, automation initiatives and digital solutions that improve business productivity.
* Recommend improvements to IT support processes, knowledge documentation and service delivery standards.
* Contribute to regional IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of customer service, collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.

**Education** 
 :

* Relevant technical certifications such as Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, CompTIA or equivalent will be an added advantage.

 :

* Experience coordinating with outsourced IT support vendors and monitoring service delivery against agreed SLAs.

* Experience supporting logistics, transportation, warehousing, manufacturing, retail or other multi\-site organisations will be preferred.

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

**About The Role**
 The Senior Security Vulnerability Remediation Specialist is a targeted Infrastructure Operations role responsible for assessing, remediating, automating, and sustaining security vulnerability fixes across Hyland's internal infrastructure. * Collaborate with Infrastructure Support and Engineering teams to identify recurring vulnerability patterns and implement protocols and procedures that prevent issues from resurfacing.
* Monitor vulnerability remediation queues, SLAs, and aging metrics to ensure commitments are met, reporting is current, and operational documentation is continuously improved.
